summary: Charlotte Melina Viall studied at the Cornell University College of Agriculture and Life Sciences from circa 1910 to 1914 and also studied at the University of Chicago.

Charlotte Vaudeville worked in Indology and religious studies, studying at the Sorbonne, the École des chartes, and under Pierre Meile, Theodor Bloch, Louis Renou, and Dhirendra Varma. She held posts at CNRS, EFEO, EPHE, and the Sorbonne.

A scholar in Tibetology and Buddhist studies, Chatral Sangye Dorje studied under numerous traditional masters, including Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang and Dudjom Jigdral Yeshe Dorje, whom he succeeded. He taught students including Keith Dowman and Gyurme Dorje.

Chatsumarn Kabilsingh works in Buddhist studies, philosophy, and religious studies, having earned degrees from Visva-Bharati, McMaster, and Magadh universities. She served in the Department of Philosophy and Religion at Thammasat University from circa 1973 to 2000.

Chen-kuo Lin, who works in philosophy and Buddhist studies, earned his PhD at Temple University in 1991. He served as Professor and Distinguished Professor at National Chengchi University and held posts at IIAS and Leiden University.
Cheng Huang has held academic posts at the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, UT Southwestern Medical Center, and Southern Methodist University.
Cheng Yen, active in Buddhist studies and religious studies, studied under Yinshun as a disciple in 1963. She founded the Tzu Chi Foundation in 1966 and Tzu Chi University in 2000.
Cheryl A. Crowley is a scholar in Japanology who studied under Linda H. Chance, William R. LaFleur, Philip Boas Yampolsky, and Ryuichi Abe.

Chhabilal Neupane, working in Indology and philosophy, earned an MA from Indira Gandhi National Open University in 2024. He taught Sanskrit at Union Academy Senior Secondary School (2019–2023) and held a post at Kameshwar Singh Darbhanga Sanskrit University in 2023.

Chheangkhy Hok works in linguistics and Indology and has held posts at the University of Heng Samrin Thbongkhmum in the Department of Khmer Literature and at the Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi.
Chhime Rigdzing, active in Tibetology and Buddhist studies, studied under Dudjom Jigdral Yeshe Dorje and held a post at Visva-Bharati University.

Chhimed Rigdzin worked in Tibetology and Buddhist studies and studied under Choying Khyabdel. He conducted research at the Italian Institute for the Middle and Far East and was Professor of Tibetan at Visva-Bharati University from circa 1957 to 1987.
Chi Chen Ho works in Buddhist studies and sinology, having completed a PhD at UCLA in 2010 under Robert E. Buswell Jr. and studied with Hsuan Hua. Ho also served as a teaching assistant at UCLA.
Chi-chiang Huang, a scholar of Buddhist studies, sinology, and history and archaeology, earned a PhD at the University of Arizona in 1986 under Jing-shen Tao, also studying under Robert M. Gimello.

Chi-wah Chan, active in Buddhist studies and sinology, completed a PhD at UCLA in 1993, studying under Robert E. Buswell Jr. and Benjamin A. Elman. Chan also served as a teaching assistant at The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
Chia Theng Shen, active in Buddhist studies, held a post at the Buddhist Association of the United States from circa 1964 to 2007 and founded the Institute for Advanced Studies of World Religions.
Chie Ikeya is a historian and archaeologist who earned a PhD at Cornell University in 2006, having studied under David K. Wyatt.
Chien Y. Hsu is a scholar of Buddhist studies who was supervised for doctoral work by Leslie S. Kawamura and James B. Apple, and studied under the traditional teacher Zhenhua.

Chien-hsing Ho works in philosophy, Buddhist studies, and Indology. Ho has held posts as Associate Professor of Religious Studies at Nanhua University (attested 2014) and at Academia Sinica (attested 2018).

Chienlin Lee earned a PhD at National Dong Hwa University in 2020. Lee served as an adjunct assistant professor at National Taitung University, project assistant professor at National Dong Hwa University, and a postdoctoral fellow at Academia Sinica in 2023.
